## Troubleshooting

- immutable[sS]{0,80}never overwrite — A published release entry must never be overwritten; losing this line reopens the clobber path. `skills/devlog/skills/devlog/skill-invariants.json:1`
- stranger test — The governing quality rule: a reader without the author's repo can build the thing. `skills/devlog/skills/devlog/skill-invariants.json:11`
- Gotchas — The post template must require the Gotchas section (lint-post enforces it mechanically). `skills/devlog/skills/devlog/skill-invariants.json:16`
